plan.cohorts: BTC/ETH/SOL January-July of 2024, 2025, 2026, exact same anchors; reset calibration each January; seven-day identity warmup INCLUDED in all metrics.
plan.comparison: All-sample paired Brier and logloss gains versus raw AND versus fixed control. 4000 seven-day moving-block bootstrap, seed271031, 99.444% intervals Bonferroni over9 cohorts for each metric/comparison separately. Conditional on saved fitted stream; no correction over historical experiments or all endpoints.
plan.control: Fixed control uses the first adaptive fit (January8) forever within that cohort; identical identity warmup.
plan.gates: Original universal.evaluate direction gate unchanged, threshold52%, all9 must pass. Probability improvement: both full-sample Brier and logloss gain lower bounds >0 on all9 versus raw. Adaptation-specific evidence separately applies the same gate versus fixed. No tuning after outcomes.
plan.parameters: Direction: sigmoid(alpha*log(p_up/p_down)), alpha in [0,1]. Flat: sigmoid(logit(p_flat)+offset), offset in [-3,3]. Joint multiclass logloss plus 1e-4*((alpha-1)^2+offset^2); separable convex roots. Recombine into three probabilities. Sign-symmetric, direction ordering preserved, no directional sign reversal.
plan.primary: Daily per-asset calibration, trailing28 days, exponential weights half-life7 days based on outcome end; minimum1000 matured observations. Never use end>day cutoff. Same rule and hyperparameters for all assets/years.
plan.protected_boundary: 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z, no new market sources or downloads; reuse only frozen pre-boundary outputs.
plan.purpose: Address overconfidence and temporal drift using only matured archived OOS forecasts; one primary adaptive method, one fixed calibration control, unchanged raw comparator.
plan.status: Retrospective exploratory follow-up: all nine raw cohort results were already seen. This does not create an untouched validation set.
